top_signals.title: Tehran criticizes Canada for not condemning Trump's threat to destroy Iran
top_signals.summary: Baqaei said that Carney chose to appease Washington by reframing a threat to "annihilate" Iran as merely "speaking the language of war."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Army awards Palantir $48.1M to modernize ammo management
top_signals.summary: The tech company has built AI software designed to process data for targeting and decision-making, and now, managing ammo.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. unveils two-month truce extension as Trump and Xi begin summit
top_signals.summary: While the truce extension ensures stability until 2027, it fell short of the three-to-six month continuation some U.S. officials had floated.
